title: Empty and explicitly blank right stacks
statement: For every alphabet $A$, integer $z$, and finite possibly blank-symbol stack $l$, the two-stack tape with frontier $z$, left stack $l$, and empty right stack is equal, as a tape function, to the one with the same frontier and left stack and a right stack consisting of a single blank cell.
replaced:
Let $z$ be an integer and $l$ a finite list of possibly-blank symbols over an
alphabet $A$. The two-stack zipper tape with frontier $z$, left stack $l$, and
empty right stack equals the zipper tape with the same frontier and left stack
whose right stack is the single blank cell.
